content: To the ends of more effective model training, we elected to expand the `Conversations Gone Awry' dataset, using the original annotation procedure. Since we found that the original data skewed towards shorter conversations, we focused this crowdsourcing run on longer conversations: ones with 4 or more comments preceding the attack. Through this additional crowdsourcing, we expand the dataset to 4,188 conversations, which we are publicly releasing as part of the Cornell Conversational Analysis Toolkit (ConvoKit).
